title: Multi-Agent Debate Prior-Run Artifact
description: Durable local artifact summarizing a prior debate run for optional reuse. This artifact changes focus and documents known context — it NEVER suppresses new findings or decisions. All fields are informational; the consuming debate run MUST generate its own independent analysis.

topic.description: The original question or requirement that was debated. Must match (or be closely related to) the current debate topic for this artifact to be considered applicable.

artifactRef.description: Local path or session-relative reference to the prior debate output (e.g. 'debate-output-2026-06-30.json'). Must be a local/run-directory artifact; global memory references are not valid here.

sessionId.description: Optional: sessionId from the prior debate metadata for traceability.

timestamp.description: When the prior debate was conducted.

priorDecision.description: Summary of the prior final decision. Non-binding — the current debate MUST independently reach its own decision.

confidenceLevel.description: Prior validator's confidence in the decision. LOW means the current debate should treat it with extra skepticism.

rejectedAlternatives.description: Alternatives that were debated and rejected in the prior run. Provides starting context, not restrictions.

critiques.description: Specific critique points that led to rejection.

unresolvedRisks.description: Risks that were identified but not resolved in the prior run. These MUST be re-examined — they are not automatically resolved by documenting them here.

coverage.description: Coverage summary for this prior debate artifact.

covered.description: Aspects of the topic that were substantively addressed.

notCovered.description: Aspects explicitly NOT covered in the prior debate (required; must not be empty if full coverage was impossible).

validatorVerdict.description: The validator verdict from the prior debate. NOT_VALIDATED means the validator gate was skipped or unavailable.

reuseConstraint.description: Explicit reuse contract. These fields MUST have the values specified below.

suppressNewFindings.description: MUST be false. Prior run data NEVER suppresses new findings in the current debate.

suppressNewDecisions.description: MUST be false. The current debate MUST independently reach its own decision.

applicabilityNote.description: Human-readable note explaining how this prior artifact is applicable and what changed since then.
